menu_options.notifications: Notifications — a banner on the screens when something happens at home

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: A banner at the top of your screens when an accessory does something — a door opens, someone arrives, a camera sees a person — with a camera’s snapshot taken that moment. Choose the accessories, and where and when banners show, on the HK Settings page: {url}

notifications_options.title: Notifications
notifications_options.description: The notifications, Do Not Disturb and where they show are on the HK Settings page: {url}

notify.name: Show notification
notify.description: Shows a banner at the top of the screens (Notifications), like one of its own: on every screen that allows notifications, or only those listed. Each screen decides as it does for any notification: Do Not Disturb, its screensaver, asleep.

title.name: Title
title.description: The banner's first line (up to 40 characters).

important.name: Important
important.description: Outlined red; gets through Do Not Disturb, and shows on a screensaver set to Important.

wake.name: Wakes the screen
wake.description: Turns a sleeping screen on, or leaves its screensaver, to show it. Makes it Important too.

stay.name: Stays on screen
stay.description: Seconds it stays; 0 until dismissed. Empty: as All Screens' Stays On Screen.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: An hk: or mdi: icon. Empty: the accessory's, or a bell.

entity.name: Accessory
entity.description: What it is about: its icon, its buttons (Close a garage door, Lock a lock), and the sheet a tap opens.

camera.name: Camera snapshot
camera.description: A camera to take a snapshot from the moment it is sent; a tap on it opens the live view.

tap.name: Tap opens
tap.description: camera (the live view), sheet (the accessory's sheet) or none. Empty: the camera, else the accessory, else nothing.

dashboards.name: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Only screens showing these dashboards (url paths). Empty: any dashboard.

users.name: Users
users.description: Only screens signed in as these users (user ids). Empty: anyone.

notifications_not_set_up.message: Notifications is not added. Add it in Settings -> Devices & services -> HK Frontend -> Add feature.
